facts_of_case: The parties were married and the trial court granted a decree of divorce. The petitioner appealed against this decision. The respondent contracted a second marriage after the appeal was filed but before it was decided.

legal_principles.principle: When a marriage has been dissolved by a decree of divorce and either there is no right of appeal against the decree or, if there is such a right of appeal, the time for appealing has expired without an appeal having been presented, or an appeal has been presented but has been dismissed, it shall be lawful for either party to the marriage to marry again.
legal_principles.held: Sri.Dileep submitted that the present appeal against the decree of divorce was not filed on time. It was delayed by 113 days.

legal_principles.principle: The burden lies on the party seeking to set aside a decree of divorce to show that the appeal was filed within the statutory time limit.
legal_principles.held: Even though the appeal and the application for condonation of delay was filed on ..2.. 17.08.2010 and this Court ordered notice on both on 30.08.2010, the appellant did not take any steps for serving notice.

outcome.final_order: The final order was that the decree of divorce was confirmed and the respondent's second marriage was valid.
